title: Cold Chain Excursion Audit Transfer
goal: Process refrigerated-shipment logger CSV data with minute timestamps, door-open flags, and some missing thermometer samples; detect each temperature excursion above the allowed threshold, merge adjacent samples into incident windows, and export a CSV listing shipment_id, excursion start/end, duration, peak temperature, and whether the incident coincided with a door opening.
skillBenefitRationale: The task is driven entirely by CSV wrangling: reading messy logs, handling missing sensor values, filtering threshold breaches, grouping contiguous incidents, and writing a tabular audit output, so csv-processing is the only critical shipped skill.
